issues.title: Under-seat structure is light grey; the real seat is black under the pan
issues.evidence: y_47302 under-pan structure #222631 L39 (black pan base, black electronics, only the white PED boxes, chrome tubes and grey legs are light); sanspotter 21 / 23 (A_ss_*-21/-23) also dark under the seat ahead. Render e10 / e11: a light grey tray (L107 in studio) runs under every pan front and the side rails / pan stiffener are the light #a3a8ae frame; in e11 it reads as a lip under the cushion.
issues.fix: 09a_econ.js: tray gRBox(0.39, 0.03, 0.40) at y 0.35 colour '#7d8187' -> '#26292f'; pan-front stiffener (line ~277) '#5d6168' -> '#26292f'; the side rails gRBox(0.04, 0.05, 0.46) at y 0.31 -> { c: '#3a3d44', r: 0.5 }. issues.title: Life-vest pouch is a black hockey puck with a long red strip; real pouch is a smoked translucent D-shaped flat pouch with a short red tab
issues.evidence: y_47302 (p02_under.png): two pouches, each a flat half-disc ~0.18 x 0.10 m, smoky translucent grey L48-66 with the vest visible inside, red pull tab ~4 cm folded on the face with a small blue/white tag. Render e10: gCyl(0.085, 0.075, 0.035) #2b2e33 (opaque round puck) and a 2 x 10 cm red strip hanging straight down below it.
issues.fix: Replace the gCyl with a half-disc: gCyl(0.09, 0.09, 0.025, 16) with its vertices clipped/scaled to z <= 0 (flat edge aft) or a lofted D, colour { c: '#3b3c44', r: 0.15 } (optionally an inner '#a08a3a' slab for the vest); move the red tab onto the front face: gBox(0.022, 0.045, 0.004) at (x0 + 0.015, 0.205, -0.43) plus a 1.5 cm white/blue tag; delete the 10 cm hanging strip.

issues.title: Pan joints still 8-13 px dark head-on (photo 2-3 px)
